title: Microplastics in settled dust from university indoor environments: Puerto Colombia, Colombia
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,332-347
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00139G, Paper

Maria Gabriela Avilés Valera, Victoria Andrea Arana Rengifo, Carlos David Grande-Tovar
The indoor university environment in Puerto Colombia, Colombia, with the highest mean MPs was the laboratory. Fibers (501–100 μm) and PET, PP, and polyester microparticles were predominant.
